scenarios.name: ParallelLLM-01 multiple calls execute and return results

steps.text: three LLM call specifications with stages stage_3, stage_3, stage_3
parallel_safe_llm_calls is called with max_workers 2
three LLMCallResult objects are returned
each result contains the validated model from the mock LLM

scenarios.name: ParallelLLM-02 results returned in input order regardless of execution order

steps.text: three LLM call specifications with steps slot_a, slot_b, slot_c
the mock LLM delays step slot_c by 100ms and step slot_a by 0ms
parallel_safe_llm_calls is called with max_workers 3
the first result has step slot_a
the second result has step slot_b
the third result has step slot_c

scenarios.name: ParallelLLM-03 failed call does not affect other calls

steps.text: three LLM call specifications with steps good_1, bad_1, good_2
the mock LLM raises an exception for step bad_1
parallel_safe_llm_calls is called with max_workers 3
three LLMCallResult objects are returned
the result for step good_1 has no error
the result for step bad_1 has an error message
the result for step good_2 has no error

scenarios.name: ParallelLLM-04 all call log entries written thread-safe

steps.text: five LLM call specifications with steps s1, s2, s3, s4, s5
parallel_safe_llm_calls is called with max_workers 4
the calls.jsonl file contains five valid JSON lines
each line has a valid stage, step, model, and timestamp
four LLM call specifications
the mock LLM records the number of concurrent in-flight calls
parallel_safe_llm_calls is called with max_workers 2
the maximum observed concurrent in-flight calls is at most 2

scenarios.name: ParallelLLM-06 single call works as degenerate case

steps.text: one LLM call specification with stage stage_3 and step slot_a
parallel_safe_llm_calls is called with max_workers 1
one LLMCallResult object is returned
the result contains the validated model from the mock LLM

scenarios.name: ParallelLLM-07 empty call list returns empty result list

steps.text: zero LLM call specifications
parallel_safe_llm_calls is called with max_workers 4
an empty list of LLMCallResult objects is returned
no calls.jsonl file is created
an LLMCallSpec with system_prompt sys, user_prompt usr, response_format LossAnalysis, stage stage_3, step slot_a, and temperature 0.7
the spec has system_prompt sys
the spec has user_prompt usr
the spec has response_format LossAnalysis
the spec has stage stage_3
the spec has step slot_a
the spec has temperature 0.7

scenarios.name: ParallelLLM-09 LLMCallResult bundles result with call_spec

steps.text: a successful parallel call execution for one specification
the LLMCallResult has model set to the LLM client model
the LLMCallResult has result set to the validated model
the LLMCallResult has error set to None
the LLMCallResult has call_spec set to the original specification

scenarios.name: ParallelLLM-10 failed call result has model None and error set

steps.text: a failed parallel call execution for one specification
the LLMCallResult has model set to None
the LLMCallResult has error set to the exception message
the LLMCallResult has call_spec set to the original specification

scenarios.name: ParallelLLM-11 call log entries include success and failure entries

steps.text: two LLM call specifications with steps good_1 and bad_1
the mock LLM raises an exception for step bad_1
parallel_safe_llm_calls is called with max_workers 2
the calls.jsonl file contains two lines
the first line has success true
the second line has success false and a non-empty error field

scenarios.name: ParallelLLM-12 temperature propagated to each call

steps.text: two LLM call specifications with temperatures 0.2 and 0.7
parallel_safe_llm_calls is called with max_workers 2
the mock LLM received temperature 0.2 for the first call
the mock LLM received temperature 0.7 for the second call
